    11	# A finite replacement for a family line bundle on a curve
    12	
    13	For a smooth proper geometrically integral curve `C/k`, a finite type affine
    14	test `Spec A`, and a line bundle `L` on `C_A`, this file constructs the finite
    15	two-term replacement of the standard Cech complex after pushing `L` forward
    16	along the finite map `C_A -> P^1_A`.

    18	Unlike the abstract existence theorem, the result below discharges every input
    19	for the campaign object: noetherianity of the affine base, flatness of the three
    20	chart-section modules, and finiteness of both Cech cohomology modules.  It is the
    21	reusable finite-complex input for the fibre Euler and Picard degree-piece route.
    22	
    23	Nothing here constructs a Picard representer or assumes a rational point on
    24	`C`.
    25	-/

    43	/-- The standard two-chart Cech complex of the finite pushforward of a family
    44	line bundle admits a finite replacement.
    45	
    46	The hypotheses are exactly those of the challenge curve and a finite type
    47	affine test.  In particular, the resulting `TwoTermFiniteReplacement` is
    48	available without a rational point on `C` and without an extra representability
    49	hypothesis. -/

    51	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    52	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    53	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    54	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    55	    (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom
    56	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules)
    57	    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    58	    let M := (Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L
    59	    let p := pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
    60	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))

  nonempty : Nonempty X := by infer_instance
  component_integral : ∀ (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U], IsDomain Γ(X, U) := by infer_instance

attribute [instance] IsIntegral.component_integral IsIntegral.nonempty

  @IsIntegral.component_integral _ _ _ ⟨Nonempty.some inferInstance, trivial⟩

    infer_instance
  · haveI : Nonempty U := by simpa
